shared_or_similar_visual_information: The direction of a marked trace on a number line or function graph. Compare the raised trace attached to the number-line mark at 2 in the left image with the raised trace attached to the number-line mark at 2 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The indicated ray selects the values below its boundary. Right image: The ray selects values below 2.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image selects values on the smaller-input side of the boundary. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
